[[File:Plexisteel.png|thumb|right]]
'''Plexisteel''' was a material that was used in the construction of some [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The dome of a [[Bartender droid/Legends|bartender droid]] working in the [[Spaceman's Rest]] on [[Rafa IV]] was made from plexisteel.<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>
